typography.heading_font: font-head (existing class - MUST be preserved and used for all headings h1-h6)
typography.body_font: Inter or Figtree (sans-serif, optimized for legibility in complex forms)
rules: NEVER use generic sans for headings, always apply font-head.
Use tracking-tight for all headings above 32px.
Price displays must use large, clear typography (text-3xl or 4xl) and high contrast.

brand.light: #E0F2FE (sky-100 - for active states or subtle highlights)

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E5E7EB on cards, minimal border-radius (rounded-md or rounded-none) for a clean, Shopify-Dawn-like Swiss aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid flat backgrounds. NO glassmorphism on main product areas to ensure price/configuration legibility. Cart drawer overlay uses bg-black/40.

layouts.spacing_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24. Use generous padding (py-16 or py-24) between major homepage sections.
layouts.product_grid: grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Images must maintain consistent aspect ratios (e.g., aspect-[4/5] or aspect-square).
layouts.pdp_layout: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12. Left (Gallery): col-span-7 sticky top-24. Right (Form): col-span-5 scrollable.

announcement_bar.style: bg-[#111827] text-white text-sm py-2 text-center flex justify-center items-center gap-2

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white border-b border-gray-200 transition-all duration-300
header.structure: Logo on left (w-32), center nav (Brochure, Business Cards, etc.), right icons (Search, Account, Cart with badge).

hero_section.style: relative w-full bg-gray-50 flex items-center min-h-[70vh] overflow-hidden
hero_section.structure: Two-column on desktop (Text left, Image right) or Full-bleed with centralized content box. Headline 'Browse our latest products', CTA 'Shop all' (pill or crisp square button in #2495D3).

product_card.style: group cursor-pointer flex flex-col gap-3 relative
product_card.sale_badge: absolute top-2 left-2 bg-red-500 text-white text-xs px-2 py-1 uppercase tracking-wider z-10
product_card.text: Title in font-head, price below. Price hidden if guest ('Sign in to view').

product_detail_page.paper_options: Side-by-side radio cards (grid grid-cols-2 gap-4) showing 'Standard', 'Premium', etc. with inline prices.
product_detail_page.add_ons: Toggle switches for Lamination, Foil, Round Corners.
product_detail_page.pricing_display: Only visible if logged in. Dynamic update. If guest: prominent banner 'Sign in to see prices' instead of Add to Cart.
product_detail_page.file_upload: Dashed border dropzone (border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 p-6). Checkbox for 'File-setup fee'.
product_detail_page.tax_breakdown: Subtotal, GST, PST, Total shown clearly before Add to Cart.

cart_drawer.style: Fixed right-0 top-0 h-full w-full sm:w-[400px] bg-white shadow-2xl z-50 transform transition-transform translate-x-0
cart_drawer.content: List of items, variant details (paper, qty), Tax breakdown, Checkout button.

auth_screens.style: Centered card layout (max-w-md w-full mx-auto p-8 border border-gray-200 bg-white).
auth_screens.features: Email/password, Google Login button (outline style), Captcha placeholder on Register. Alert banner for 'Email verification required'.

account_orders.order_stepper: Visual progress bar: Received -> In production -> Ready -> Completed. Green (#10B981) for completed steps.

motion.hover: Images in product cards scale up slightly (scale-105) with transform duration-500 ease-out.
motion.drawers: Slide in from right (translate-x-full to translate-x-0) using ease-in-out duration-300.
motion.page_load: Fade in primary elements using simple opacity transitions.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #2495D3 button passes WCAG AA.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#2495D3] focus-visible:ring-offset-2.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-expanded on dropdowns, aria-hidden on decorative icons.
accessibility.test_ids: CRITICAL: Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn', data-testid='login-submit').

media.rules: NEVER use generic placeholders (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided Unsplash/Pexels URLs. Apply object-cover to all images.

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENT A STOREFRONT SEPARATE FROM ADMIN. Do not alter existing admin dashboard layouts or styles. Add layouts to customer-facing routes.
Use Shadcn UI for interactive forms (Select, Tabs, Dialogs, Checkboxes) but apply custom Tailwind classes to match the 'Swiss/Dawn' aesthetic (remove heavy default Vercel radii).
Integrate the font-head class into heading components (H1-H6).
GUEST VS LOGGED IN: Build conditional rendering for prices. Guests see catalog but NO prices and NO add-to-cart. They see a 'Sign in to view prices' button.
Product Detail Page configuration must feel like a modern print shop (like Vistaprint or Moo) with side-by-side selectable cards for paper types.
Order Stepper in Account area is critical for print shops. Implement a visually clear horizontal or vertical step tracker.
Use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Avoid importing heavy icon packs unnecessarily.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but avoid muddy gray transparency.
Never apply transition: all globally. Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
Do not center-align the app container (no .App { text-align: center; }). Keep text left-aligned for readability.
Use modern button styles (sharp or slightly rounded corners) with interaction animations. Limit use of primary color (#2495D3) to main CTAs.
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Missing categories/images MUST NOT fallback to placeholder text. Use the provided media URLs.
Prioritize reusing existing UI components if available, but adapt their styling to this storefront.
Ensure the shopping experience feels distinct, high-quality, and completely separate from the internal ERP tool.
